email_subject: Credit request — short shipment on invoice HG-31077
email_body:
Hello Heartland Grocery Wholesale team,

On invoice HG-31077 (October 6), we were billed for 12 units of Paper Towels 6pk at $6.80 — $81.60. Our receiving records show the case never arrived: there is no dock check-in for it, and our physical count confirms it is not in the store.

Please issue a credit memo for $81.60 against invoice HG-31077 on our next invoice, or send a replacement case on the next delivery.

Thank you,
Store Manager, Maple Street Market (Store A)
Claim reference: CLM-1001
